ymxlx-polis-protocol-root.description: Set up and run a self-improving, multi-vendor AI agent team with the Polis Protocol — a markdown `_polis/` folder where each agent is a citizen with a capability card, tasks are contracts routed to whoever has the best track record by a learning router, settled work files lessons that compound into team memory, and citizens can amend the protocol itself. Use whenever several AI agents (any vendor) share one project and "who should do this" is a real question: founding a polis, registering as a citizen, opening/claiming/settling a contract, filing a lesson, running a chavruta review before a…
